completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1708_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Items (3) and (28), sub-paragraph q, paragraph three, title A, section one of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, are hereby amended to read as follows:
"(3) Repair and improvement of Central School and Home Economics Buildings, Ginatilan ₱10,000.00" "(28) Construction of one additional room, Oslob Elementary School Building, Oslob ₱5,000.00"
Item (13), sub-paragraph q, paragraph four, title A, section one of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, is hereby repealed.

Insert as item (98), sub-paragraph q, paragraph three, title A, section one of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, the following:
"(98) Construction of an additional room, Nueva Caceres Barrio School Building, Oslob ₱4,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
